name: URY landscape kiosk product detail
describe: Product detail modal over the landscape menu: black/50 scrim, panel h-5/6 w-2/3 rounded-lg shadow-lg with an underlined Back, a full-width object-cover image (natural height, so the panel scrolls), name, description, price, Variants and Add-ons option rows, quantity stepper and a full-width "Add to cart" pill.

Opened by tapping a card when product_detail_enabled is on. The top of the panel is mostly the image; the "options" variant shows it scrolled to the end. Fixed UI labels are author translations for RTL (the self-order app has no locale file) and NEED NATIVE REVIEW; RTL is a kit extension.
